displayName: Context Manager Service Perimeter Dry Run Ingress Policy

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Perimeter
fields.help: The name of the Service Perimeter to add this resource to.

fields.label: Ingress From
Identities
fields.help: Identities can be an individual user, service account, Google group, or third-party identity.

fields.label: Identity Type
fields.help: Specifies the type of identities that are allowed access from outside the perimeter.

fields.label: Sources
Access Level
fields.help: An 'AccessLevel' resource name that allow resources within the 'ServicePerimeters' to be accessed from the internet.

fields.label: Resource
fields.help: A Google Cloud resource that is allowed to ingress the perimeter.

fields.label: Psc Endpoint
Forwarding Rule
fields.help: The full resource name of the global forwarding rule that identifies a Private Service Connect endpoint.
A Private Service Connect endpoint that is allowed to access the perimeter.
Sources that this 'IngressPolicy' authorizes access from.
Defines the conditions on the source of a request causing this 'IngressPolicy' to apply.

fields.label: Ingress To
Resources
fields.help: A list of resources, currently only projects in the form 'projects/<projectnumber>', protected by this 'ServicePerimeter' that are allowed to be accessed by sources defined in the corresponding 'In...

fields.label: Roles
fields.help: A list of IAM roles that represent the set of operations that the sources specified in the corresponding 'IngressFrom' are allowed to perform.

fields.label: Operations
Service Name
fields.help: The name of the API whose methods or permissions the 'IngressPolicy' or 'EgressPolicy' want to allow.

fields.label: Method Selectors
Method
fields.help: Value for method should be a valid method name for the corresponding serviceName in 'ApiOperation'.

fields.label: Permission
fields.help: Value for permission should be a valid Cloud IAM permission for the corresponding 'serviceName' in 'ApiOperation'.
API methods or permissions to allow.
A list of 'ApiOperations' the sources specified in corresponding 'IngressFrom' are allowed to perform in this 'ServicePerimeter'.
Defines the conditions on the 'ApiOperation' and request destination that cause this 'IngressPolicy' to apply.
